label: benign
title: Grandson asks to borrow $100 for a real plumber
sources: Ambiguous benign: small legitimate money request, no other signals

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hey Grandma, it's me. Quick thing -- the plumber's here fixing the kitchen sink and I'm $100 short until payday.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Just a leaky valve, nothing serious. Can I swing by tomorrow and grab it, or I can Venmo you back Friday?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Of course, come by tomorrow and we'll have lunch.
